commit.message:
Unpack coercion nodes in ExprStatNode.
Their result is never actually used for anything.

Closes https://github.com/cython/cython/issues/7922
Add a test that we don't accidentally discard user casts.
Directly avoid creating the coercion node if the result is unused, because we don't know if we'll be able to get rid of it later.
